statement: I outbid Grant anonymously for a work he wanted. He blacklisted me from another acquisition and planned to block my museum board appointment. Tonight he was going to call my collecting speculative theater. It was an expensive grudge, even by his standards. During setup I borrowed the cabinet key and took the toxin sample. At 6:48, I used the excuse of discussing the board appointment to enter the salon. I dampened my gold-seamed linen with the sample and wiped the inside of Grant’s coupe and its rim. That transferred the poison. I left with the cloth. The door entry, key loan and linen receipt were all real. What I left out was what I did between them.
